title: Symmetry of coordinate noise probabilities
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{−1,1\}$. Under the coordinate noise rule that keeps its input sign with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flips it otherwise, the probability of moving from $x$ to $y$ equals the probability of moving from $y$ to $x$.
